fact: Cameroon's Ministry of Public Health annual bulletin reports 2022 weekly reports from health facilities across the country's regions and districts received in the DHIS2, with 83.7% of health districts meeting the 90% completeness norm.

The Ministry of Public Health bulletin gives cumulative 2022 DHIS2 completeness of facility reports as 86.25% and timeliness as 76.6%, against 77.37% and 62.1% in 2021 (DHIS2 extract of 16 January 2023).
The bulletin's event-based surveillance table reports 94.0% of detected signals integrated into the DHIS2 in 2022, tying disease surveillance signals to the DHIS2.
